outcome: ratio of peak systolic velocity and end-diastolic velocity (S/D)
pulsatility index (PI) of fetal umbilical artery (UA), middle cerebral artery (MCA), and renal artery (RA)
cohort: 149 singleton pregnancies between 36 and 41 weeks gestation without pregnancy complications
finding: Nuchal cord, especially tight nuchal cord, affects fetal hemodynamics by altering flow parameters in the renal and umbilical arteries, potentially increasing the risk of fetal distress.
